steps.caption: Integrations
steps.narration: Once HOVER is connected, its measurement reports land in the CRM on their own.

steps.caption: Connected
steps.narration: On Integrations, the HOVER card says connected. You sign in to HOVER one time to set that up.

steps.caption: Webhook verified
steps.narration: Webhook verified means HOVER tells the CRM when a job is completed.

steps.caption: The last sync
steps.narration: The last sync found three jobs, and matched all three to clients by address.

steps.caption: Auto-sync
steps.narration: Auto-sync also checks on a schedule. Every six hours is the default.

steps.caption: Sync now
steps.narration: To check right away, choose Sync now.

steps.caption: Nothing new
steps.narration: Nothing new this time. All three jobs are already up to date.

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Now look at a client whose house was measured.

steps.caption: Measurements
steps.narration: Further down the page, Measurements holds the HOVER report. Nobody typed it in.

steps.caption: Matched by address
steps.narration: It was matched to this client by the address of the house.

steps.caption: Roof, siding, windows, pitch
steps.narration: Roof and siding area, windows, stories and pitch are all filled in.

steps.caption: 3D model and PDF
steps.narration: The 3D model and the PDF report open from the two links on the right.

steps.caption: Project Photos
steps.narration: And the picture HOVER took of the house is saved under Project Photos.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find the HOVER card under Integrations, in the left menu.

youtube.title: How HOVER measurement reports reach your clients | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: See what the ConstructHUB CRM does once your HOVER account is connected: completed jobs sync on their own, each report is matched to the client at that address, and the measurements, PDF and 3D model sit on the client's page. Recorded in a demo workspace with stand-in HOVER jobs.
